_doc: Historical 2026-09-27 review snapshot EV138-145. All these rows are also in canonical gate_evidence.json, which is the complete machine-readable docket.

entries.caught: Reviewer alleged a provider-declared successful plain-text refusal without refusal metadata could earn cache credit.
entries.severity: medium alleged; rebutted as outside explicit response metadata contract
entries.author_initially: Original R02 fixes known missing-key/spec and explicit incomplete/metadata refusal paths, not semantic classification of arbitrary provider-declared success text.
entries.resolution: Official run --context carried call-site and original-finding evidence. Clearing gate_20260927-013524.md accepted full patch; commit notary adjudicated first finding rebutted-upheld. No keyword refusal classifier added. Known refusals/incomplete responses are denied new completion credit; historical unmarked cache compatibility limitation documented.

entries.caught: app.queue_tokens rebuilt full prompts and expensive static enrichment whenever Streamlit displayed an unchanged pending queue.
entries.author_initially: Full prompt overhead was correctly estimated, but repeated display work was uncached.
entries.resolution: Remediated in73313cf: retain current-queue session estimates, invalidate source/path/mode/settings/prior/spec/template/builder-version changes. Actual regression RED on two builds instead of one, then GREEN; final focused pytest75 passed. First estimate may still run selected tools and is documented. Independent prewrite CLEAR and final commit CLEAR required and obtained.

entries.layer: exact-byte pre-write reviews; Qwen3.8Flash and user-selected openai/gpt-6-luna-pro
entries.caught: Iterative proposal reviews exposed real edge cases: incomplete retry overwriting completion/history, ambiguous source relocation, missing new-save completion evidence, nonstring response persistence, Windows filename length, batch summary disk failure, linked-root spelling, output-copy/cache ordering, scanner import ordering, deeply nested JSON, and nested legacy report-directory relocation.
entries.author_initially: Initial R01-R17 proposals did not cover every interaction.
entries.resolution: Confirmed findings repaired with regression coverage before exact bytes applied. False/stale claims were refuted using proposed bytes, runtime probes and call-site contracts (including UI old variable names, NUL-abspath claim, and intentional TDD RED phases). No BLOCK was converted into author-supplied clearance. Long owned Qwen scanner request cancelled without verdict, unchanged proposal independently cleared by GPT Luna.

entries.caught: Snapshot list comprehension retains all staged blobs before bounded payload composition, permitting excessive memory use.
entries.resolution: Replace eager list with ordered generator in canonical Tools, sync marketplace exact bytes. Regression snapshot_defers_staged_blob_reads observed failing before fix. Regression avoids optimization-removable assertions after reviewer followup.
entries.author_initially: Confirmed findings accepted after source/reproducer verification; factual objections were carried back to the same reviewer.

entries.caught: Unlocked fallback artifact check/write could collide after lock or persistence failure.
entries.resolution: Return failure with no clearance when no durable artifact exists; preserve existing durable partial-artifact handling. Snapshot regression observed RED then GREEN.
entries.author_initially: Confirmed findings accepted after source/reproducer verification; factual objections were carried back to the same reviewer.

entries.layer: Canonical broker size denial; Luna Pro commit review
entries.caught: 411KB central docket could not be repaired through the250KB write cap; commit review also identified string refs violating array contract.
entries.resolution: Canonical broker independently reviewed repair raises per-file bound to450000 bytes and enforces900000-byte complete serialized payload cap. Large complete payload and escaping-expansion tests observed RED then GREEN;13 broker and9 enforcement tests pass. All historical string refs wrapped in arrays with text preserved and central JSON remains CRLF/no BOM.

entries.resolution: Reproduced failed small-case with inherited promotion; explicitly disable Jev in both deterministic e2e fixtures. Both pass after fix; separate Jev behavior tests retained.

entries.caught: Reviewers questioned owner-selected fallback order, missing override scan attribution, documented degraded adjudication append, and human docket link absent from code-only payload.
entries.resolution: Retained owner model order. Override is owner exemption rather than external scan. Adjudication append failure remains explicitly loud and nonblocking by existing contract; summary stays in note but detailed episode can be lost. Human docket link is staged but Markdown is intentionally absent from code payload. Carry factual context into canonical gate.
